detail.longDescription: My relation with AI is "love-hate" one. I like many things that AI allows or help me with, but I hate a lot of other things. It would be too long to explain it, but also no one would read it, so I'm even trying to post it I'm super torn and internet dividing to 2 bubbles (anti vs AI bros), both delusional, is not helping. You cannot have any real discussion anymore talking about nuances, because one of mentioned 2 tribes will attack you. # ai # artificialintelligence # claude # chatgpt # europe
